command:
set -eu
cfg=/tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf
umask 077
printf '%s\n' \
'[req]' \
'distinguished_name = dn' \
'x509_extensions = v3_ca' \
'prompt = no' \
'[dn]' \
'CN = OS Comparison Root CA' \
'O = OS Comparison' \
'[v3_ca]' \
'basicConstraints = critical, CA:true' \
'keyUsage = critical, keyCertSign, cRLSign' \
'subjectKeyIdentifier = hash' \
'authorityKeyIdentifier = keyid:always' > "$cfg"
sudo -n install -d -m 700 /etc/pki/tls/private
sudo -n openssl req -new -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -config "$cfg" -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
rm -f "$cfg"
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract
printf '%s\n' 'CA generated and trust database updated'
sudo -n stat -c 'key_mode=%a key_owner=%U:%G key_path=%n' /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n stat -c 'cert_mode=%a cert_owner=%U:%G cert_path=%n' /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem

command:
set -eu
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
key=/etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
bundle=/etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt
printf '%s\n' '--- installed certificate identity ---'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
printf '%s\n' '--- CA extensions ---'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | grep -A2 -E 'X509v3 Basic Constraints|X509v3 Key Usage'
printf '%s\n' '--- private key and certificate match ---'
cert_md5=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -modulus | openssl md5)
key_md5=$(sudo -n openssl rsa -in "$key" -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl md5)
[ "$cert_md5" = "$key_md5" ]
printf 'key_certificate_match=yes\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- system trust verification ---'
openssl verify -CAfile "$bundle" "$cert"
printf '%s\n' '--- p11-kit trust classification ---'
trust list | grep -F -A4 -B1 'OS Comparison Root CA'
printf '%s\n' '--- retained platform ---'
cat /etc/redhat-release
uname -r
